note: Each entry documents a known gap: a feature-gated test with no CI executor. Every entry MUST have a written reason. Remove an entry only by ADDING a CI executor that covers it (a feature-matrix leg or coverage.sh case arm). Do NOT use this file to silence a new test's coverage requirement — add the executor instead.

allowlist.reason: No feature-matrix leg for rdf12-triple-terms yet (tracked gap). The feature is non-standard, off by default, and the test is the only consumer. A future leg will close this gap.

hdt excluded from the feature-matrix lane by design: the wrapped hdt crate declares MSRV 1.87 and pulls a heavy C/cmake decode stack (see feature-matrix.yml SCOPE comment). Gating it needs its own toolchain lane — tracked as a future bead.
sparq-hdt write excluded from the feature-matrix lane by the same MSRV 1.87 / heavy-C rationale as sparq-cli/hdt (see feature-matrix.yml SCOPE comment).

literature-live opens a real network connection to the Anthropic API. Live-network tests are never run in CI by contract (the eval harness uses recorded fixtures). Excluded by the same policy as nlq/live and embeddings (see feature-matrix.yml SCOPE comment).

tests/preset_live_conformance.rs is an opt-in probe that drives the driver presets against EXTERNAL SPARQL engines (Blazegraph, GraphDB, QLever, MillenniumDB, Fuseki, Oxigraph, Virtuoso) named by SPARQ_METAMORPH_* environment variables. Every test is #[ignore]d and additionally self-skips when its endpoint variable is unset, so no CI executor can ever make one run — the same live-network-off-in-CI contract as sparq-kb/literature-live, nlq/live and vectors/embeddings (see feature-matrix.yml SCOPE comment). This is NOT a coverage gap to be closed with a leg: bit-rot protection already exists, because ci.yml's workspace-wide `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` compiles and lints the file. The pure request-building layer the presets configure is unit-tested without sockets in src/driver.rs.

sparq-reason-dl is not yet wired into any CI executor: it is absent from PER_COMMIT_CRATES in coverage.sh and has no feature-matrix fragment. The dispatch feature drives the L4 fragment-dispatch checker (sq-pbz04.4.4). Tracked gap: add a sparq-reason-dl fragment with a dispatch leg.

snomed_go_scale.rs requires BOTH rbox and hasse simultaneously (a combined SNOMED/GO scaling test). Separate legs exist for rbox alone and hasse alone, but no combined leg covers the AND requirement. Tracked gap: add a combined rbox,hasse leg to sparq-reason-el fragment.
